title: Product Marketing Manager
summary: A product marketing manager decides how a product is described and sold: who it is for, why it beats alternatives, and how it reaches the market at launch. The role sits in marketing at product companies and links the product, sales and customer success teams.
dailyDuties: Write and refine positioning and messaging for products
Plan launch timelines with product, sales and design
Build pitch decks, battlecards and sales training
Interview customers and sales reps for buyer insights
Track competitors and update comparison material
Measure launch results and report to leadership

skills.expectation: Write positioning and messaging for each product and audience
Plan and run product launches with product, sales and design
Build pitch decks, battlecards and train the sales team
Track competitors and run win/loss analysis
Define buyer personas and the ideal customer profile from research
Write web pages, case studies and launch content
Align product, sales, customer success and marketing teams
Present product stories to sales, customers and leadership
Measure launch impact on adoption, activation and pipeline
Contribute to pricing and packaging decisions
Pull pipeline and campaign data from a CRM
Read website and funnel data for launch pages
Plan launch and product update emails

certifications.why: Free course on inbound content and email that product marketers support
